name: Generic electrical load
summary: A generic electrical load identifies a documented consuming circuit or aggregate load on an SLD.
description: A generic electrical load identifies a documented consuming circuit or aggregate load on an SLD. It is used where the equipment details are supplied through a load schedule or linked schematic.
readingNotes: Read the load description and ratings rather than assigning a motor function to every load endpoint.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A generic load does not imply a specific motor, heater or converter construction.
